answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in ferrous, expire in falcon, and plume lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 144 aliases as a result needs 93 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4710 identities would post 3271 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
